the NMR spectra of amorphous alloys are the superposition of the NMR spectra corresponding to the microregions of different short-range order types, and the NMR spectra for microcrystallites are the superposition NMR spectra of microcrystallite and of the amorphous matrix.

the amorphous alloys have a complex atomic structure, and the structure of the amorphous Fe–B alloys consists of microregions (clusteres) with short-range orders of tetragonal and ortorhombic phase types of Fe3B and of α-Fe type.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the local atomic structure of the amorphous and nanocrystalline Fe–B alloys, which are the most widely used soft magnetic materials.
the local atomic structure of the microcrystallized Fe-B alloys, which are formed by crystallization of amorphous alloys.
the study of amorphous alloys of Fe-B in the composition range 4–25 at % B.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the local atomic structure of the amorphous alloys is a mixture of short-range order of Fe-B phases of the tetragonally and orthorhonomically distorted α-Fe type, as well as the short-range order of α-Fe.
the amorphous FeB alloys consist of micro-regions of the Fe3B-phase type and the α-Fe-type.
the amorphous Fe–B system consists of clusters with the short-range order of FeB, Fe2B, and α-Fe phases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the NMR spectra of Fe-B alloys in a wide range of compositions and temperatures have been measured, the local atomic structure of Fe-B alloys has determined, and the phase diagram of the Fe-B system has been constructed.
the local structure of the amorphous Fe3B alloys has a complex nature.

the local atomic structure of the amorphous Fe3B alloys consists of microregions (cluster) with short-range ordering of the tetragonally distorted Fe3B-type and orthorhobically distorted α-Fe type, as well as α-Fe-type microregions.

the local atomic structure of microcrystallized Fe-B alloys in a wide composition range (4 to 25 at% B) is determined by the presence of the Fe3B phase in microregions with the short-range order of this phase type.
amorphous FeB alloys consist of microclusters with the short-range order of Fe3B-type and α-Fe-type.
